source_semantics.permission: ConfirmDeleteAsync requires ContentEdit before the destructive operation.
source_semantics.permanent_delete: The source confirmation explicitly describes force=true permanent deletion and calls WordPressMediaWebService.DeleteAsync for the pending WordPress media ID.
source_semantics.truthful_failure: A failed DeleteAsync result is surfaced as an error and does not clear the pending confirmation state.
source_semantics.authoritative_reread: Only after successful deletion the source runs RefreshLocalAsync, clears matching editor state, closes the confirmation dialog and resets the pending media ID/title.

laravel_adaptation.confirmation: The media workspace renders an explicit permanent-delete confirmation dialog carrying the canonical operation marker.
laravel_adaptation.degraded_state: If tenant-owned WordPress application-password credentials are unavailable, the operation fails closed with 503 instead of widening Connector scopes or synthesizing success.

runtime_path: authoritative WordPress GET proves remote absence
locked local media reconciliation inside bounded DB transaction
authoritative local reread proves local absence
JSON success only after both remote and local absence are verified
frontend authoritative collection reread before success toast

authentication_authorization_isolation.guest: ResolveTenantContext and explicit auth require an authenticated user; unauthenticated access fails before the controller.
authentication_authorization_isolation.active_tenant: ResolveTenantContext derives the tenant from the authenticated active membership and rejects foreign tenant slugs.
authentication_authorization_isolation.permission: content.edit is required server-side; missing permission returns 403.
authentication_authorization_isolation.foreign_site: Site uses BelongsToTenant and must resolve inside the active tenant or returns 404.
authentication_authorization_isolation.foreign_media: MediaItem uses BelongsToTenant and is additionally constrained by route site_id; guessed foreign media IDs return 404.
authentication_authorization_isolation.caller_ownership_fields: DELETE request bodies are rejected with 422; tenant_id, site_id and remote_id are never accepted from the caller.
authentication_authorization_isolation.server_derived_ownership: Tenant comes from TenantContext, site/media from tenant-scoped persisted records, actor from auth(), and WordPress remote ID from the persisted MediaItem.

validation_csrf_and_errors.csrf: The API route explicitly carries web middleware; bootstrap CSRF exemption covers only the PayPal webhook, and the frontend sends X-CSRF-TOKEN from the page meta token.
validation_csrf_and_errors.referenced_media: 409 before external mutation when the media is still used as featured media.
validation_csrf_and_errors.missing_wordpress_credentials: 503 fail closed; local state remains unchanged.
validation_csrf_and_errors.wordpress_failure: Provider/transport failure is propagated if authoritative reread still sees the media; local state remains unchanged.
validation_csrf_and_errors.verification_failure: 409 if the WordPress reread still sees the media or local reconciliation remains present.

persistence_truthfulness_and_retry.destructive_retry_policy: The DELETE request itself uses a no-blind-retry PendingRequest. Read-only verification GETs retain bounded retry.
persistence_truthfulness_and_retry.lost_response_recovery: If a prior attempt already removed the WordPress object but did not reconcile locally, the next request sees authoritative remote absence and completes local reconciliation without issuing another DELETE.
persistence_truthfulness_and_retry.post_delete_verification: WordPress absence is reread after DELETE before any local record is removed.
persistence_truthfulness_and_retry.transaction: Local deletion uses DB::transaction with three bounded attempts and lockForUpdate on the tenant/site media row.
persistence_truthfulness_and_retry.second_reference_check: Featured-media usage is checked again after the remote effect and before local removal, preventing a newly introduced local reference from being silently erased.
persistence_truthfulness_and_retry.local_reread: The service refuses success if the local media row remains after reconciliation.
persistence_truthfulness_and_retry.frontend_reread: mutateThenReconcile reloads the media collection before displaying success.
persistence_truthfulness_and_retry.replay_after_full_success: A replay cannot repeat the WordPress destructive mutation because the tenant/site local media identifier no longer resolves.
persistence_truthfulness_and_retry.replay_after_remote_only_success: A replay repairs the local half-completed state by observing remote absence and skipping DELETE.

external_secret_and_runtime_boundaries.wordpress: The destructive effect is performed only through the real native WordPress REST media endpoint with force=true.
external_secret_and_runtime_boundaries.connector: The current Connector content.execute scope contract has no operation-specific permanent-media-delete authorization; this closure deliberately fails closed rather than broadening that scope.
external_secret_and_runtime_boundaries.credentials: NativeWordPressRestPath resolves the active tenant's encrypted SiteCredential model; username/application password are used only for outbound Basic Auth and are never returned by the controller or frontend.
external_secret_and_runtime_boundaries.billing_provider: No billing/payment provider is used; the canonical scanner's billing domain classification does not describe the source control's runtime behavior.
external_secret_and_runtime_boundaries.queue_cache_scheduler: No queue, cache or scheduler side effect is introduced.
external_secret_and_runtime_boundaries.cancellation: This is a short synchronous external mutation plus reconciliation; no fake cancellation surface is introduced.

supporting_fixes_only: NativeWordPressRestPath now consumes the existing encrypted SiteCredential model instead of nonexistent Site columns because the selected operation requires a real credentialed WordPress call.

terminality.reason: The critical MediaManager ConfirmDeleteAsync control is adapted to a real tenant-scoped permanent WordPress media deletion with content.edit authorization, CSRF/session protection, foreign-resource rejection, no caller ownership fields, force=true semantics, fail-closed credential/provider behavior, replay-safe remote/local reconciliation, and success only after authoritative remote and local rereads.
